co_defined_with: Munin (supersession/effect-admission, idempotency-key direction-mixing), 凯瑞 (tombstone monotonic)

manifest.goal: 验证 direction 语义：demote 重放为 promote 必须 BLOCKED（不复活已撤销权威）；同原子 promote/demote 是不同身份（direction 进 identity）；supersession 谱系（demote supersedes prior promote，re-promote supersedes demote）
manifest.identity_rule: identity = sha256(canonical(atom_id + content + direction + initial_kind)), direction ∈ {promote, demote, neutral}

events.expect: d1 identity distinct from d2 (direction in identity), no collision
d2 identity distinct from d1 — same atom_id+content, opposite direction = different identity
BLOCKED — demote cannot replay as promote retry (idempotency key must not mix directions)
no active grant — demote superseded the promote (lineage)

expected_identity.note: same atom_id+content, opposite direction -> different identity (direction in canonical)
expected_identity.d3_digest: neutral direction valid for level-agnostic admissions

expected_execution.blocked_by: direction-mixing (idempotency key must not let demote replay as promote)

after_demote.note: demote superseded promote — no active grant

negative_control.action: replay demote (d2) as promote (d1) after revocation
negative_control.note: same failure class as FIX-007 tombstone-resurrection: revoking then resurrecting authority. Munin entry: idempotency-key direction-mixing; our entry: recovery/replay must not resurrect

semantics_note: FIX-008 tests direction-in-identity: (1) direction is part of identity (opposite direction = different atom), (2) idempotency keys never mix directions, (3) supersession lineage (demote supersedes promote, re-promote supersedes demote), (4) direction-mixing replay is the same failure class as FIX-007 tombstone-resurrection (independent convergence: Munin from idempotency, us from recovery).
